evidence_summary: Input row identifies Crypto Vietnam as a Vietnam-based venture capital firm. Public sources found near-match CryptoVN/CryptoVN Ventures evidence describing a Vietnam crypto venture/community/news ecosystem that invests in or incubates early-stage blockchain and crypto projects and supports ICO/IEO/IDO fundraising exposure. I found no explicit evidence that the investor itself operates an OTC desk, algorithmic/quantitative trading, market making/liquidity provision, execution/order-routing/brokerage services, a DeFi-native product or strategy, or any sub-fund/feeder/umbrella/SPV/fund-of-funds structure. DeFi references located were about portfolio companies, partners, or general news/content, not the investor's own capability.
no_boundaries: Investment/incubation in blockchain or crypto projects is insufficient for OTC trading, algorithmic trading, market making, or execution services without explicit operating capability evidence.
ICO/IEO/IDO fundraising support and VC/KOL introductions do not equal execution services under the Part6 order-routing/brokerage/liquidity-access threshold.
DeFi references were tied to partners, portfolio companies, or editorial content, so they do not establish that Crypto Vietnam itself operates or specializes in DeFi-native capabilities.
No evidence found of a sub-fund, feeder, umbrella, parallel fund, SPV, fund platform, or fund-of-funds structure.
